objectives.description: Add vocabulary-agnostic splitter: title, preamble, ordered (header, body) pairs
Add stage-layout reassembler: title + preamble + retained pairs in order
Identify run-order section, strip/rebuild its coverage appendix
Replace Phase 2 stage refusal branch in mode_regenerate with real path; set RUNS_COUNT/RETAINED_COUNT
Add stage-layout fixture faithful to real regression fixture shape
Add round-trip, idempotence, appendix-replacement test cases
Verify against real BimodalLogic fixture read-only via scratch copy

notes: split_sections locates sections BY LINE-NUMBER POSITION (one grep -n pass), not by re-matching header text like extract_section does -- this matters because extract_section's text-match approach would double-capture/merge if two stage sections ever shared identical header text, which a hand-authored stage layout could plausibly do (duplicate '## Stage N' headers are not structurally prevented). body_has_orchestrate_fence/roadmap_has_orchestrate_fence were refactored into a body-string primitive plus a thin file-reading wrapper, since mode_regenerate_stage needs the same predicate applied to an in-memory section body (to locate the run-order section among already-split sections) that detect_layout already applies to a whole file. Verified read-only against BimodalLogic's real specs/ROADMAP.md (commit c9ea5ac36): --regenerate --dry-run now exits 0, and the diff is confined to ONE added coverage-appendix block (tasks 127,128,709,729,730,731,741 were uncovered-ready); no Stage 0-4 content or rationale prose touched; the live file's sha256sum is confirmed unchanged.
